rounds.text: Om Metallogic Ltd is exceptionally under-appreciated by the market, trading at an ultra-low P/E ratio of just 5.29x alongside a price-to-book value of 0.67x on a book value of ₹ 47.3 [E1, E2]. This severe undervaluation is starkly highlighted by a discounted cash flow intrinsic value estimation pointing to ₹ 244 per share against a market price of ₹ 31.7, leaving a massive margin of safety of 87.0% [E33, E34]. Furthermore, a reverse DCF indicates that today's price incorrectly assumes a negative 11.2% earnings growth, completely ignoring the company's robust historical performance [E35]. This strong operational footing is backed by consistent multi-year growth, including a 3-year compounded sales growth of 26% and a remarkable 3-year compounded profit growth of 62% [E14, E16]. Profitability metrics remain equally impressive, supported by a 3-year median return on equity of 27% and an ROCE of 17.24% that comfortably outpaces the sector benchmark [E10, E19, E40]. Meanwhile, management has aggressively strengthened the balance sheet by reducing borrowings down to ₹ 4.25 Cr in March 2026, resulting in a conservative debt-to-equity ratio of just 0.11x [E28, E29, E38]. conceded: [E24]
